# GMEOW Finance Module

The GMEOW Finance Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/finance>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/finance`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Personal and SMB financial existence: accounts, monetary amounts, transactions, ledgers, invoices, orders, asset holdings, and crypto wallets. Grounded in the existing Event/Participation/Agreement/Rights/Trust substrate. FIBO, schema.org, ISO 4217, ISO 20022, FIGI and OFX are aligned by reference, never imported.

DOCTRINE.
  * A financial account is an InformationObject (consistent with OnlineAccount): it is fundamentally an information construct — an IBAN, account number, and balance record. The legal/contractual aspect is modelled separately via Agreement (account terms between holder and bank).
  * Money is a MonetaryAmount = amount (xsd:decimal) + currency (ReferenceFrame individual). DL-clean; no arithmetic in OWL.
  * Currency is a ReferenceFrame in the frameRealmCurrency realm (Principle 11 — frame-relativity). Each ISO 4217 code is a ReferenceFrame individual.
  * accountCurrency is NON-FUNCTIONAL: a single FinancialAccount may hold balances in several currencies (multi-currency fintech accounts). The functional constraint moves to Posting/Holding relators.
  * A transaction is a reified Event (REA pattern): money movement with Agent participants in roles (payer / payee / intermediary) — reuse Event/Participation, never re-mint.
  * Double-entry as structure: LedgerAccount (asset / liability / equity / revenue / expense — open vocab), JournalEntry ⊑ Event, Posting ⊑ gufo:Relator (account × amount × debit/credit); balance (Σ debits = Σ credits) enforced by SHACL, not OWL.
  * Loans are Agreements; invoices are Documents; ownership is rights; banks are Organizations; wallets hold trust keys — reuse, don't duplicate.
  * Open value vocabularies, no overtyping (Principle 9): account types, transaction types, transaction statuses, ledger account types, posting directions, asset types, invoice statuses, order statuses, and payment methods are individuals, never subclasses.
  * Flat-first, reify on demand: a flat accountBalance on FinancialAccount covers the 80% case; promote to a Holding relator when cost-basis, period, or provenance matters.
  * Sensitive: P9/P10 + provenance. Reversed/voided transactions are displayable false, retained as the audit trail, never deleted; disputed amounts coexist accordingTo; every figure carries confidence/wasAttributedTo.
